tools.name: audit_practice_footprint
tools.description: Checks a therapy practice's Google Business Profile and (optionally) its website for local-search gaps, and returns a 0-100 setup score with prioritized, therapist-appropriate fixes. Use when a therapist asks how findable their practice is, why they aren't showing up on Google, or what to fix first. Free; limited to 3 different practices per caller per week (repeat audits of the same practice return the saved report).

practice_name.description: The practice name as it appears on Google, e.g. "Calming Connections Counseling".

city.description: City the practice is in, e.g. "Snohomish".

website_url.description: Optional practice website URL, to also check page title, meta description, headings, and local-business schema.

tools.name: write_sample_google_post
tools.description: Reads a therapist's public practice homepage and writes one Google Business Profile "What's New" post (150-300 words) in that therapist's voice. Follows therapist ethics: no client stories, no outcome promises, no review requests; calls to action point to the practice website. Use when a therapist wants an example post or help getting started posting on Google. Free; cached per website for 30 days; 5 new posts per caller per day.

website_url.description: The therapist's public practice website, e.g. "https://www.example-counseling.com".

tools.name: get_ariadne_overview
tools.description: Returns factual information about Ariadne, the marketing assistant for therapists in private practice: what it does, who it's for and not for, pricing, and its ethics and privacy rules. Use when someone asks what Ariadne is or whether it fits their practice.
